name: Investigate the Scourge of Stormwind
summary: Scourge forces press against Stormwind, with necropolises looming beyond its walls. Lieutenant Orrin calls defenders to strike their camps, gather Necrotic Stones, and study the runes there.

sections.title: Undead at the Capital's Threshold
sections.body: Scourge forces have reached the outskirts of Stormwind City. Necropolises float overhead as undead and cultists take hold near the kingdom’s greatest bastion. Lieutenant Orrin gathers defenders outside the city to drive them back before they threaten the capital.

sections.title: The Whispering Runes
sections.body: Glowing runes mark the dirt around Scourge camps, and their purpose remains unclear. The circles crackle with magic like that of the necropolises and carry eerie whispers. Lieutenant Orrin can only guess who, if anyone, hears those unnatural voices.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Orrin is an officer coordinating Stormwind’s defenses. He works with the Argent Dawn and organizes local fighters to gather intelligence and break up Scourge footholds near the city.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge attacking Stormwind?
faq.answer: The Lich King has sent necropolises and invasion forces across Azeroth to spread terror and swell the ranks of the undead. Stormwind is a major stronghold of the living, making it a target for the Scourge.

faq.q: What are the glowing runic circles?
faq.answer: The Scourge has placed glowing runic circles near its camps. They pulse with dark magic and carry unnatural whispers, though their purpose is not known.
Dim Necrotic Stones are magical objects carried by lesser Scourge forces. They hold lingering necrotic energy and interest the Argent Dawn.

faq.q: What role does the Argent Dawn play in this mission?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn is an independent order that fights the Scourge wherever it appears. Lieutenant Orrin works with the order to secure intelligence and stones for its war against the Lich King’s armies.

faq.q: Are the runic circles dangerous to approach?
faq.answer: The circles give off unsettling energy and discordant whispers. Careful scouts can approach them and learn about Scourge communications without losing their sanity.

angles.text: For the Alliance, defending Stormwind’s gates is a matter of survival. The Scourge has reached even this southern stronghold.
As a Paladin, you face the Scourge outside Stormwind and can bring holy wrath against its runes while protecting the kingdom’s people.
As a Priest, you can study the twisted whispers in the runes and learn about the shadow magic binding the Scourge’s frontline forces.
